title: Half-circle patch, front view
caption: One small, rounded patch sits at the center of the front hairline against an otherwise close-shaved scalp.
patternDescription: The short front tuft contrasts with evenly shaved stubble around the scalp. The fictional model's appearance does not establish a natural hair subtype.
lengthDescription: Very short across the scalp, with a small area of slightly longer hair forming the front half-circle.
